decision: Approve the exact finite candidate scope, its coverage/execution mapping and 120-criterion same-profile closure, and applicability of the two exact native reuse requests listed below. SNR-1 through SNR-4 are resolved for this frozen input. This is not implementation-source, installed-artifact, current-head CI, hardware or promotion approval.

resolved_findings.reason: The resource scenario observes positive CPU/GPU buffer and resource-texture deltas, then equality with the resource baseline before survivor close or reference release. The same survivor/widget and canvas allocation remain live, and all three Python resource references remain in the list. The canonical decoder now requires the complete retirement object, all ten gauges with strict nonnegative integer types, positive pre-delete deltas, equal post-delete/baseline states, live survivor, positive canvas allocation and exactly three references. Separate actual Program, Texture2D and VertexBuffer suppressed-delete controls fail at this pre-close oracle on both profiles.
resolved_findings.neutral_tint_assessment: The constant all-ones tint is bounded observer instrumentation for the already selected Program operation. It creates a real 16-byte Program-owned constant attribute buffer while preserving the independently expected red/green/blue pixels; together with the existing 24-byte position buffer this gives the observed 40-byte ownership delta. It makes the Program-specific suppression distinguishable without relying on vacuous input-cache gauges. It introduces no selection/API key or criterion and grants no broader shader capability claim.

resolved_findings.reason: Both flush routes now record immediate pre/post-finish snapshots before readback/event processing. The decoder joins pre-finish counters to the just-observed flush snapshot, requires exactly one finish call, increased completion waits, unchanged presentation, monotonic submission/retirement counts and drained pending state. The actual no-op finish control fails before later readback can supply completion.

Actual full-extent second-target RGBA is checked before second.update/repaint and then first-target selection is restored. The canonical decoder requires the observed blue RGBA and rejects boolean-as-color substitution. The retained actual corruption control writes yellow to the second native target while retaining its cached PhotoImage and is rejected before repaint on both profiles.

The canonical closed decoder now requires and validates every new finish, untouched-target and retirement field. It is pinned by the candidate preparation tools. Fresh real source composites call capture and the bound decoder in the interpreter that ran the scenario. Independent replay accepts both exact real payloads, returns all eight required branches, rejects all 33 resealed new-field corruptions per payload and accepts all 60 source criterion bindings per profile.
